api.bad-fields: The request is not valid. Fields with issues:
api.internal: Something went wrong in CedarLoom. The details are in the terminal where cedarloom-app runs.
apply.backup-failed: stopped and the file was not changed.
apply.no-hard-links: is on a volume without hard links, such as exFAT, FAT or some network shares. CedarLoom needs them to replace a file, or put one back, without leaving it half written. Move the project to a volume with hard links, such as APFS, NTFS or ext4.
apply.recovered: was left from the interrupted run
apply.unsettled: , so nothing was changed. Check that CedarLoom may change the files there and that no link is on the way, then try again.
apply.write-mismatch: does not match the plan after the write. Run
to see which steps were written.
cli.bad-value: is not a valid value for
cli.confirm-required: This plan was not applied. Run the command again with --yes to apply it.
cli.flag-conflict: These options cannot be used together:
cli.internal: CedarLoom stopped on an unexpected error. Please report it with the output above.
cli.value-not-json: must be JSON; write a text value in quotes, for example '"opus"'.
definition.invalid: . The plugin's generator/generate.mjs names them when run on it from the project's root with --prefix '' --out .claude --check.
definition.name-mismatch: , which is not its file name without .json. Rename the file or change its name field so that both match.
definition.not-json: cannot be read, or is not valid JSON.
definition.stale: The files generated from the workflow definition
differ from what the plugin's generator writes now:
. Run cedarloom workflows generate to plan the writes and deletes, and add --yes to apply them. It deletes only files it wrote, so delete yourself any other listed file the generator does not write.
edit.outputs-left: No CedarLoom run recorded the files generated for the old name
. Delete them yourself if they are not needed.
edit.result-over-limits: The edited definition would be larger than
levels, more than CedarLoom reads. Nothing was changed.
generate.delete-skipped: is no longer generated, but it changed since it was written, so CedarLoom kept it. Delete it yourself if it is not needed.
generated.file-unreadable: cannot be read, so CedarLoom did not check whether it is a generated file.
generated.folder-unreadable: cannot be read, so the generated files in it were not checked.

timeout: did not end within its time limit and was stopped
outputLimit: printed more than its output limit and was stopped

generator.output-unknown: The workflow generator printed output CedarLoom cannot read:
plan.file-changed: changed after CedarLoom read it, so CedarLoom did not overwrite it. Review the file, then run the command again.
plan.folder-denied: keep CedarLoom from reading or writing
as it is. Check those permissions, then try again.
plan.name-not-portable: holds a character Windows does not allow in a file name (< > " | ? * or a control character), so the plan cannot be applied.
plan.name-too-long: leaves no room for the temporary names CedarLoom writes beside it, so the plan cannot be applied. Use shorter names, or a project folder with a shorter path.
plan.not-text: is not a UTF-8 text file of at most 16 MiB, or CedarLoom may not read it. CedarLoom writes only text files it can read.
plan.path-nested: and another path of the plan use one name as both a file and a folder, so the plan cannot be applied.
plan.path-outside-roots: is outside the folders CedarLoom writes to (.claude/ and .cedarloom/workflows/).
plan.path-through-file: A folder on the way to
is a file, so CedarLoom cannot write
plan.spelling-clash: differ only in letter case or Unicode form, and this volume keeps them as two files. CedarLoom treats them as one path, so the plan cannot be applied.
plan.stale: The plan changed since it was shown. Review the new plan before you apply it.
plan.symlink: is a symbolic link. CedarLoom does not write through links.
plan.text-mismatch: does not match the plan's hash, so the plan cannot be applied. Make the plan again.
plugin.disabled: , so the workflows generated for this project will not run.
plugin.marketplace-untrusted: , not from the CedarLoom/cedarloom repository, so CedarLoom will not run its plugins. Name a plugin folder you trust with --plugin-root.
plugin.not-found: The cl-workflow plugin from the CedarLoom marketplace is not installed for this project in
. Install it with claude plugin marketplace add CedarLoom/cedarloom and then claude plugin install cl-workflow@cedarloom, or name a plugin folder with --plugin-root.
plugin.record-unknown: cannot be read or has a shape CedarLoom does not know, so the plugin cannot be located. Name the plugin folder with --plugin-root.
plugin.too-old: ) has no workflow generator. Update the plugin.
plugin.trust-bypassed: from --plugin-root. Its origin was not checked.
plugin.untrusted: is not cl-workflow from the CedarLoom marketplace, so CedarLoom will not run its generator.
project.git-unreadable: is neither a folder nor a file that starts with "gitdir: ", or it cannot be read, so CedarLoom cannot tell which project this folder is in. Nothing was changed.
project.not-found: is not inside the working tree of a Git repository. Run CedarLoom from your project folder.
recovery.skipped: was left from the interrupted run
and could not be settled: the filesystem refused a change there, or a link is on the way. No change is made until it is settled.
server.port-in-use: is in use. Choose another with --port, or leave it out to use a free port.
session.cookie: No valid session. Open the link that cedarloom-app printed.
session.csrf: The request is missing its session check. Reload the page.
session.origin: Requests from other sites are refused.
session.token: This link was already used or has expired. Run cedarloom-app again for a new one.

false: was set outside CedarLoom, and this plan changes it from true to false. Undo the run to set it back.
other: was set, changed or removed outside CedarLoom, so CedarLoom did not touch it. Change it yourself if needed.

settings.unreadable: cannot be read, starts with a byte order mark, is not a JSON object, has a duplicate key CedarLoom would change, or its enabledPlugins, permissions or permissions.deny has the wrong type, so CedarLoom will not use or change it. Fix the file first.
store.locked: is in use by another CedarLoom process, for example a running cedarloom-app. Stop it, or make the change from the UI.
store.version-unsupported: The CedarLoom state store has version
, and this version of CedarLoom reads only version
undo.backup-changed: no longer matches its recorded hash, so the run cannot be undone.
undo.backup-missing: is missing, so the run cannot be undone.
undo.file-changed: changed after the run, so undo would lose that change. Nothing was restored.
undo.replaced: was undone again later by run
, so an older undo of it can no longer be brought back.
undo.result-kept: left it, and this undo would leave run
counted as undone. Nothing was restored.
workflow.name-invalid: is not a valid workflow name. Use at most 166 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, and no name Windows keeps for a device, such as con, nul, com1 or lpt1.
workflow.no-script: has no workflow script to switch off.
